answer: Admission auctions block fake identities. Each epoch opens 200 slots for sealed bids; winners lock bids for 20 epochs. It is a bridge with lanes, so extra traffic cannot squeeze through. An attacker needing 1,000 identities must win 1,000 slots; at 60 days of rewards each, that costs 60,000 days. An honest agent selling walnuts pays one bid, recovers in 6 epochs, and keeps undiluted rewards. A ledger mirrors bids, so duplicates are disqualified.
